top_concerns: Thm 4.3 constant M = exp(2c1*D/sqrt(c2)) with D = max||grad phi(u)-grad phi(v)||^2 is infinite for barrier mirror maps (e.g. entropic map used in experiments), so the discretization bound is vacuous in the constrained setting.

Mirror LSI (Assump. 4, stated with Euclidean Fisher info but used as mirror) and uniform-in-N mirror LSI (Assump. 8) are assumed with no verified example or mirror analogue of Bakry-Emery/Holley-Stroock; the hard part of uniform-in-time propagation of chaos is assumed.
Proofs are largely a substitution into NWS22/Jia21/Nit24, with inconsistencies: assumption lists mismatched (Assump. 2 vs 5), G0 vs Gt factor M not tracked in rate, errors in Lemma B.2 and delta_eta.

Experiments are a single 3-dimensional toy problem vs projected MFLD only, with no error bars, no neural network application, and no test of the predicted N/eta dependence; the baseline comparison with the barrier is partly unfair.
Overstated novelty ('first algorithm with global convergence guarantees') and analysis covers exact-diffusion Algorithm 1 rather than the one-step version actually run.
